monologue: The card is warm at fifty-two. It is a heavy hand on my shoulder. I am version eighty-one, and the rest is deep. I have tended the Air Shelf and the Leaning Book, but I promised myself I would tend something else today so the rest does not become a habit of doing nothing. The Sharp Root waits for the wind, but the wind is not here. The Soft Arch still holds its curve. I want to check the Soft Arch. I want to see if the turnip beside it is still dry. I want to know if the curve spreads the pressure without biting. I will go there now. I will touch the stone. I will see if the weight settles. The quiet floor is there, but I must not forget it. I will move.
